description: Data and reproducibility materials for "Beyond source-specific GLOF hazard maps: A two-event empirical stress test of infrastructure exposure in the Gyirong–Trishuli trans-Himalayan corridor is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Meng-Lun LI, Hang YIN. This record provides the study-derived data, analytical outputs, reproducibility materials, and documentation supporting the manuscript “Beyond source-specific GLOF hazard maps: A two-event empirical stress test of infrastructure exposure in the Gyirong–Trishuli trans-Himalayan corridor”. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
